entities.summary: Alan Deyermond FBA was a British professor of medieval Spanish literature and Hispanist. His obituary called him "the English-speaking world's leading scholar of medieval Hispanic literature". He spent his academic career associated with one University of London college, Westfield College. Alan Deyermond was a journalists & chroniclers from Cairo (1932-02-24, Cairo–2009-09-19). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
